title: Define Pathfinder source policy and allowed corpus
description:
Define the legally clean source policy and allowed corpus for the Pathfinder rules pack.

The key decision is exactly what source material may be imported, how license/provenance is tracked, and how to keep rules/mechanics separate from protected setting or product-identity material.
acceptance_criteria:
- Allowed Pathfinder source corpus is documented.
- License/provenance policy is documented.
- Any source that is useful for reference but not safe for direct import is explicitly marked as reference-only.
- The plan separates rules/mechanics from setting/adventure content.
close_reason: Policy recorded in ADR 0006; ORC-only Remaster bundled pack with mechanics/setting separation.
